generate_profiling_shell_scripts: run the python script to generate Nsight Systems profiling shell scripts for DDPPO PointNav
configure_step_range_capture: edit capture_start_step and num_steps_to_capture to profile a specific training step range
configure_slurm_distributed_profiling: set do_slurm to True and adjust slurm parameters to profile across multiple nodes
configure_cuda_opengl_tracing: set capture_cuda or capture_opengl to True to include GPU or OpenGL traces in profiles
configure_local_profiling: set do_slurm to False to generate a local profiling shell script instead of Slurm scripts
